_readme: Tracks every real problem_library.json/ma_library.json item that has been pulled VERBATIM (not varied) into a generated QR/MA speed set, so a future set's planner never re-offers the same real item even though its 'status' field in the source library never gets updated. Check this file IN ADDITION TO status=='not_done' before selecting a real item for a new slot. Entries are added once a set is published (viewable by her), not only after grading, since publishing is the point of exposure. NOTE 2026-10-21: an MA set can also legitimately pull from problem_library.json (the QR library), not only ma_library.json -- the two libraries are filed by capture-time judgment call, not a hard content boundary, and many exercise names/formats overlap. Check both before inventing. Entries from the QR library used in an MA set are tracked under a "_from_qr_library" suffixed key so it is clear which library the global_id belongs to.
